_about: Commentary templates per match event type. Placeholders: {player}, {team}, {assist}, {minute}, {secondary}, {opponent}, {score}, {detail}. Several lines per type so the feed does not repeat itself.
kickoff: The referee blows and {team} kick off against {opponent}.
Kick-off. {team} versus {opponent}, and we are away.
chance: {player} has a chance for {team} but cannot convert.
Half a chance for {player}. Nothing comes of it.
goal: {player} scores! {assist} with the pass, and {team} lead the celebrations. {score}.
It is in! {player} tucks it away and {team} have a goal. {score}.
{player} beats the keeper and {team} are on the board. {score}.
A cool finish from {player} and {team} score. {score}.
ownGoal: Own goal! {player} turns it into his own net and {team} profit. {score}.
Disaster for {player}. It comes off him and in, and {team} score. {score}.
penaltyAwarded: Penalty to {team}! {player} is brought down by {secondary}.
The referee points to the spot. {secondary} fouled {player} inside the area.
penaltyScored: {player} sends the keeper the wrong way. Penalty scored for {team}. {score}.
No mistake from {player} from twelve yards. {score}.
penaltySaved: Saved! {secondary} guesses right and keeps out {player}.
{player} hits it low but {secondary} gets down to save the penalty.
penaltyMissed: {player} blazes the penalty over the bar.
Off the post! {player} cannot convert for {team}.
save: {player} tests the keeper and {secondary} holds on.
{secondary} is equal to a well-struck effort from {player}.
{player} lets fly and {secondary} turns it behind.
corner: {team} win a corner. {player} will take it.
freeKick: Free kick to {team} in a promising position.
{team} have a free kick. {player} stands over it.
A chance from a set piece for {team}.
foul: {player} pulls back {secondary} and the referee spots it.
secondYellow: A second yellow for {player}, and he is off! {team} are down to ten.
{player} is sent off after a second booking. {team} must reshuffle.
redCard: Red card! {player} is sent off for {team}.
Straight red for {player}. {team} play on a man short.
injury: {player} is down and needs treatment. That looks bad for {team}.
Injury worry for {team}: {player} cannot continue at full speed.
offside: Offside. {team} had broken clear but the linesman had it right.
tacticChange: The {team} bench sends out new instructions: {detail}.
halfTime: The referee ends the first half. {score}.
fullTime: That is the end of the match. {score}.
extraTimeStart: Level after ninety. We go to extra time.
Extra time begins with the score at {score}.
extraTimeHalf: The teams swap ends for the last fifteen minutes. {score}.
shootoutStart: Still level. This will be settled by a penalty shootout.
A penalty shootout will decide it.
shootoutEnd: It is {team} who go through, winning the shootout {score}.
goal:counter: GOAL on the break! {player} finishes off a lightning counter for {team}. {score}.
{team} break at speed and {player} scores. {assist} with the pass. {score}.
Straight down the other end and {player} punishes them. {score}.
chance:blocked: {player} gets his shot away but it is blocked.
{player} shoots and a defender throws himself in the way.
Blocked! {player} could not find a way through for {team}.
{assist} tees up {player}, but the shot is charged down.
chance:post: Off the woodwork! {player} so nearly scores for {team}.
{player} rattles the post. {team} are inches away.
chance:offTarget: {player} shoots from the edge of the box and it flies wide.
{player} has a sight of goal but drags it off target.
{assist} slips it through to {player}, who can only find the side netting.
{player} tries his luck from distance. Not far away.
{team} break and {player} snatches at the finish. Wide.
